title: Seeking a Friend
mainIdea: Kindness means caring for others even when they need extra help.

pages.text: Mateo always wanted a kitten. One day, his mom took him to an animal shelter.
At the shelter, Mateo saw an old cat named Santiago.
Santiago was old and had health problems.
Mateo explained that everyone sometimes needs extra help and care.

options: He chose another cat from a different cage

pages.text: After spending time with Santiago, Mateo knew he was the friend he wanted to bring home.
